CrashLoopBackOff.title: CrashLoopBackOff
CrashLoopBackOff.simple: The container starts and exits right away with an error; Kubernetes keeps restarting it, waiting longer each time.
CrashLoopBackOff.risk: Affected copies serve no requests. If all replicas are in this state the application is down.
causes: Application error at startup (configuration, unreachable dependency such as a database)
Missing environment variables or configuration files
Too aggressive liveness probe killing the container

HighRestarts.title: Frequent restarts
HighRestarts.simple: The container is running but restarted many times recently.
HighRestarts.risk: Every restart drops in-flight requests; it can degrade into CrashLoopBackOff.

ImagePullBackOff.title: ImagePullBackOff
ImagePullBackOff.simple: Kubernetes cannot download the container image, so the container cannot start.
ImagePullBackOff.risk: New copies of the application do not start. If it affects all replicas the application is down.
causes: Registry not reachable from the nodes

OOMKilled.title: OOMKilled (out of memory)
OOMKilled.simple: The container used more memory than its limit and was killed by the system.
OOMKilled.risk: The container is restarted: in-flight requests are lost and it tends to repeat under load.
causes: Memory limit too low for the real load
JVM/runtime settings not matching the limit

Pending.title: Pending (waiting for a node)
Pending.simple: The Pod has not been assigned to any node: Kubernetes cannot find a place to run it.
Pending.risk: Missing replicas do not start: reduced capacity or application down.
causes: Not enough resources (requested CPU or memory above what is free)
Node taints not tolerated by the Pod

CreateContainerConfigError.title: Container configuration error
CreateContainerConfigError.simple: The container cannot be created because a configuration item it references is missing.
CreateContainerConfigError.risk: The container does not start until the configuration is fixed.
causes: Missing key inside a ConfigMap or Secret

CreateContainerError.title: Container creation error
CreateContainerError.simple: The runtime cannot create the container.

RunContainerError.title: Container start error
RunContainerError.simple: The container was created but the runtime cannot start it.
causes: Command not present in the image

PodFailed.title: Pod failed
PodFailed.simple: All containers of the Pod have terminated and at least one failed; the Pod will not be restarted.
PodFailed.risk: The work of the Pod was not completed.
causes: Pod evicted from the node for lack of resources

PodUnknown.title: Pod status unknown
PodUnknown.simple: Kubernetes no longer hears from the node running the Pod, so it does not know whether the Pod works.
PodUnknown.risk: The Pod may not serve requests; controllers will recreate it elsewhere after a timeout.
causes: Network problem between node and control plane

WorkloadUnavailable.title: Application unavailable
WorkloadUnavailable.simple: No replica of the application is ready ({{available}}/{{desired}}).
WorkloadUnavailable.risk: The service may be unavailable for users.
causes: All Pods failing (see the related Pod problems)
Not enough resources in the cluster

WorkloadDegraded.title: Application degraded
WorkloadDegraded.simple: Only part of the replicas are ready ({{available}}/{{desired}}).
WorkloadDegraded.risk: Reduced capacity: under load or if another replica fails the service can degrade further.

RolloutStuck.title: Rollout stuck
RolloutStuck.simple: The progressive update could not complete within the expected time (progressDeadlineSeconds).
RolloutStuck.risk: Different versions coexist; new replicas do not become ready.

DeploymentPaused.title: Rollout paused
DeploymentPaused.simple: Updates of this Deployment are paused: template changes are not applied.
DeploymentPaused.risk: No immediate risk, but changes are pending.
causes: Manual pause to batch several changes

JobFailed.title: Job failed
JobFailed.simple: The Job exceeded its retry limit without completing.
JobFailed.risk: The scheduled task (e.g. backup, processing) did not run.

NodeNotReady.title: Node not ready (NotReady)
NodeNotReady.simple: The node does not communicate properly with the cluster: Kubernetes does not use it for new Pods and, after a few minutes, moves its Pods elsewhere.
NodeNotReady.risk: Pods on the node may not work; cluster capacity is reduced.
causes: Full disk or exhausted memory on the node

NodePressure.title: Node under pressure
NodePressure.simple: The node reports a resource pressure condition ({{condition}}).
NodePressure.risk: Kubernetes may evict Pods from the node to reclaim resources.

NodeCordoned.title: Node in maintenance (cordon)
NodeCordoned.simple: The node is marked unschedulable: it receives no new Pods.
NodeCordoned.risk: Reduced capacity until the node is put back in service (uncordon).

PVCPending.title: Volume pending (PVC Pending)
PVCPending.simple: The disk space request has not been satisfied yet: no volume is attached.
PVCPending.risk: Pods using this volume cannot start.
causes: Volume waiting for its first Pod (WaitForFirstConsumer)

PVCLost.title: Volume lost
PVCLost.simple: The bound PersistentVolume no longer exists.

KubernetesUnreachable.title: Kubernetes unreachable
KubernetesUnreachable.simple: Scarlet cannot talk to the Kubernetes API server.
KubernetesUnreachable.risk: Cluster monitoring and operations are unavailable.

PodmanUnreachable.title: Podman unreachable
PodmanUnreachable.simple: Scarlet cannot talk to the Podman API.

image_format.label: Image name
image_format.fail: The image name is not valid.

image_tag.label: Tag
image_tag.warn: The tag "{{tag}}" is mutable: different versions can end up on different nodes.

tag_exists.label: Image/tag exists
tag_exists.ok: No "not found" error in the events.
tag_exists.fail: The registry says the image or tag {{tag}} does not exist.
tag_exists.unknown: No events available to verify it.

registry_reachable.label: Registry
registry_reachable.fail: The registry {{registry}} is not reachable (network, DNS, TLS or timeout).
registry_reachable.unknown: No events available to verify it.

registry_auth.label: Authentication
registry_auth.fail: The registry denies access: missing or wrong credentials.
registry_auth.warn: Private registry ({{registry}}) without imagePullSecrets on the Pod.

platform_amd64.label: linux/amd64 architecture
platform_amd64.ok: The image is available for linux/amd64.
platform_amd64.fail: The image is not available for linux/amd64 (available: {{platforms}}).

exit_code.label: Exit code
exit_code.fail: The last run ended with code {{exitCode}}.

liveness_probe.label: Liveness probe
liveness_probe.ok: No liveness probe failure in the events.
liveness_probe.fail: The liveness probe fails: Kubernetes kills the container because it considers it stuck.

memory_limit.label: Memory
memory_limit.fail: The last termination was caused by memory exhaustion (OOMKilled).

memory_limit_set.label: Memory limit
memory_limit_set.warn: No memory limit set: the container can be killed when the node runs out of memory.

memory_usage.label: Current memory usage
memory_usage.ok: Current usage well below the limit.
memory_usage.warn: Current usage above 80% of the limit.
memory_usage.unknown: metrics-server not available: usage cannot be measured.

cpu_capacity.label: CPU capacity
cpu_capacity.ok: The requested CPU fits the nodes.
cpu_capacity.fail: Not enough CPU: {{requested}} cores requested, the largest node offers {{maxNode}}, or nodes are already full.

memory_capacity.label: Memory capacity
memory_capacity.ok: The requested memory fits the nodes.
memory_capacity.fail: Not enough memory: the Pod request exceeds the free memory or that of the largest node.

taints.label: Node taints
taints.warn: Some nodes have taints the Pod does not tolerate (e.g. control-plane or unreachable node).

node_selector.label: Node selectors / affinity
node_selector.fail: No node matches the Pod nodeSelector/affinity.

keys_exist.label: Keys
keys_exist.fail: A required key does not exist in the ConfigMap/Secret.

kubelet_heartbeat.label: Kubelet heartbeat
kubelet_heartbeat.fail: No signal from the kubelet for {{ageSeconds}} seconds.

storage_class_exists.label: StorageClass
storage_class_exists.fail: StorageClass "{{storageClass}}" does not exist in the cluster.

waiting_first_consumer.label: Binding
waiting_first_consumer.warn: The StorageClass creates the volume only when a Pod uses it (WaitForFirstConsumer): this is normal until a Pod mounts it.

local_present.label: Image present locally
local_present.ok: Image {{image}} is present in the Podman storage of this host.

archive_checksum.label: Archive checksum
archive_checksum.ok: The SHA-256 checksum matches the .sha256 file.
archive_checksum.fail: The checksum does NOT match: the archive was modified or is corrupted.

exitMeaning.completed: 0: the process ended without errors (but a service should not end)
exitMeaning.app_error: 1: generic application error: read the logs
exitMeaning.command_not_found: 127: command not found in the image
exitMeaning.killed: 137: killed with SIGKILL (often out of memory)
